Officer's narrative
Officer responded to a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped in the travel lane when the front of
Driver 2's vehicle struck the rear of the stopped vehicle. Driver 2 reported pain in the right shoulder and was
evaluated at the scene. The nature of the impact and the forces involved are consistent with the injury Driver 2
described. Driver 1 and Driver 2 both confirmed that Passenger was riding in Driver 1's vehicle at the time, and the
statements of both parties agree on this point. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the rear of Driver 1's
vehicle and the front of Driver 2's vehicle, and the visible damage is largely in line with the reported impact. No prior
damage to either vehicle was noted by the parties or observed by the officer. No independent witnesses were
identified at the scene. Driver 2 stated that Driver 2 lives with the policyholder, Driver 1, in the same household. Both
vehicles were driven from the scene, and no citations were issued at this time pending further review.
